title: Seaya Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: Home Highlights: - GULF side and across from the Seaside Town Square - STEPS to the beach with access to private East Ruskin Pavilion - Ocean views on every floor - Elevator services all floors of this cottage (residential elevator, not wheelchair accessible) - Living spaces with TVs on all 3 floors - Two adult sized beach cruiser bikes - You will have a total of 14 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - Fully stocked Kitchen with additional coffee bars - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $140/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaya is a breathtaking, GULF SIDE 5 bedroom, 3-story cottage with water views on every floor! This sprawling beach retreat offers 3 KING master retreats with private baths, spacious designer kitchen with high end appliances throughout, living rooms on every floor with wet bars and breakfast nooks flanking the bedrooms, upscale technology & TVs throughout, and an elevator to help you reach each level with ease. Conveniently located across from the Seaside square. Seaya sits just one cottage back from the beach offering the easiest beach access in Seaside! The first floor boasts 2 bedrooms; one with two sets of bunk beds (sleeps 4) and the other with two double beds (sleeps 4) with new bedding. Each room has its own private full bathrooms. A sitting room in the middle with flat screen TV separates the two bedrooms. The second floor offers a spacious living room with another area to watch TV and French doors take you to a sprawling balcony with breathtaking gulf views. Just off the living room is an over-sized gourmet kitchen and dining room. Stainless appliances and a high-end range will delight the chef in the family, while the eat-in kitchen has dining space for 10 and bar seating for 3 allowing the whole family to gather for those beach-side dinners. Up one more level to the third floor, guests will enjoy a third living room, wet bar/breakfast bar, flat screen TV and decorative fireplace. A 2nd KING master suite is on this level with beautiful master bath and designer tub. A 3rd KING master suite is also on this level with full bath. Just off the bedrooms is another sprawling balcony with outdoor dining space and lounge seating. Accommodations: (sleeps 14) First Floor: Bedroom 1: Two double beds (sleeps up to 4), private full bathroom with tub/shower combo Bedroom 2: Two sets of Twin bunk beds (sleeps 4), private full bathroom with tub/shower combo, TV. A sitting room in the middle with flat screen TV separates the two bedrooms. Laundree room is on first floor. Second Floor: Bedroom 3: Master suite- King bed, private bath (shower only), TV Fully stocked kitchen, half bath, Living area with TV Third Floor: Bedroom 4: Master Suite- King bed, beautiful ensuite master bath and designer tub, TV Bedroom 5: Master Suite- King bed, ensuite full bathroom, TV Living area with additional seating between the 2 king suites, TV ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $140/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market.
